project.name: Destiny OS :: Scenario
project.description: Scenario orchestration (Master Spec section 11): which engines apply to a real-world question, at what applicability level, and feeding their signals into Fusion. Depends on the engine SPI and destiny-execution's task runner, never on a concrete destiny-engine-* module - a scenario is wired to concrete engine instances by its caller (destiny-app), which keeps this module as engine-agnostic as destiny-fusion.
